_doc: PLACEHOLDER — R28-4 game menu (CLAUDE.md REINTERP AMENDMENTS §4, docs/REINTERP_RESTRUCTURE_R28_2026-07-10.md §4 layer 2). Frame-voice text is functional and near-final by nature (menu labels, the static controls list) — but still Sérgio's to confirm, especially restartConfirmBody's exact wording and whether the pauseGlyphSymbol reads right at a glance (a plain 'II' first pass, cheap to swap for an icon later). S80 adds the look-mode-3 strings: the motion* set (the on-screen button that asks for device orientation — iOS cannot be asked without a real press, so the button is a designed object) and 'recentre' (the menu row that puts forward back where the room's front is). ⚑ S77 adds the unvoicedName* set — THE UNVOICED OPT-OUT for 2026's deadname beat. It is in the FRAME and never in the fiction (Sérgio, 2026-08-06: 'if it is in the menu setting, then it's okay'; 08_STATUS_REGISTER §8 decision 10), because an opt-out the apparatus grants you is not an opt-out. It never removes the meaning: the subtitle still shows that the system used a name the person does not use. Its companion is the advisory on the pre-fiction panel (data/strings/orientingCard.json's nameNote), which is where a player finds out the setting exists. ⚑ READER-PASS-RETIRED with the beat itself. All of it frame voice: functional, undecorated, never in the piece's own voice. ⚑ S87 adds creditsBallSources/creditsOffersSources (two new rows under Credits) and ballSourcesTitle/offersSourcesTitle (the headings of the two new sub-views) — plain menu labels for the two stranded E4 dossier cards' sourced apparatus (data/provotypes/e4_ball.json, e4_offers.json), same PLACEHOLDER-draft status as every other row here.
title: Menu
xrRestartNote: Starting again ends the headset session. Put it back on from the start screen.
leaveNote: Opens a different, plain page outside the story. You can come back from it.
_docLeaveNote: ⚑ S220 (his, 2026-10-08: 'leave needs a small message saying that it will [go to] a different space'). Under the main menu's Leave as a quiet line (no extra press: this Leave is the quick exit from a shared room); as the body of the leave note LambyOS's Start menu opens, with Leave / Stay. Frame voice.
unvoicedNameOff: Lines about her old name: read aloud
unvoicedNameOn: Lines about her old name: shown, not read aloud
unvoicedNameNote: In the last part, a system treats Maya's former name as current — “the old file”. It never says the name. Press the row above to switch: “not read aloud” shows those lines as subtitles only.
soundMixRow: Sound levels — music, rooms, voices, effects

music.label: Music
music.note: Songs, jingles, the loops and the scores.

room.label: Rooms
room.note: The hum and weather of each room and of the passages between.

voices.label: Voices & tapes
voices.note: Spoken lines, L, the notice read aloud, the tapes.

effects.label: Effects
effects.note: Presses, chimes, start-ups, the small games' sounds.

soundMixNote: Each slider sets one kind of sound; zero silences just that kind. The mute row above silences everything at once. Sound is held while this menu is open, so a change is heard when you resume. Nothing here is kept: a restart returns to the starting levels.
_docSound: ⚑ S248 — the one mixer (src/audio/mix.ts). The lead (2026-10-15): a volume slider on the menu, and the same for each kind of sound. The exhibition laptop runs at system volume 100%, so the starting master is 0.7 and every file is levelled to a baseline (src/audio/levels.json). Frame voice, plain.
soundMuted: Sound: muted — press to hear it again
captionsOn: Sound captions: every sound named in the strip
captionsOff: Sound captions: off — spoken words still shown
restartConfirmBody: This wipes everything and returns you to the start. Nothing you do is ever kept, either way.
controlsLines: Drag — or hold the arrow keys — to look around.
On a phone or tablet, turn the device to look — the button at the bottom of the screen switches that on.
Pinch with two fingers — or scroll the wheel — to zoom the view in or out.
Recentre the view turns you back to face the front of the room.
Fullscreen is available from this menu when the browser supports it.
Esc — or this menu's corner button — pauses.
motionEnableHint: Turn your phone or tablet to look around the room.
motionDenied: Motion access declined. Drag to look.
motionUnavailable: No motion sensor here. Drag to look.
creditsNone: No third-party assets to credit yet.
creditsCloseSources: The Close's panels — sources & further reading
creditsSourcesPage: All sources, with their links — opens a web page ↗
closeSourcesIntro: The four panels say what happened. This says how well each part of it is documented — documented, disputed, or inferred — and where to read. A press on a panel in the sky turns it to the same.
yourFile: Your file — what the systems recorded
yourFileIntro: Everything below was filed by the software in the piece, in the order it happened. It is held in this browser's memory only and is gone when you leave. Under each entry: what the system was doing, how well that practice is documented, and where to read.
yourFileNoSource: no source — this beat is the piece's own
_docYourFile: ⚑ S144 — THE DOSSIER'S READING (docs/reinterp/THE_RECORD_PLAN_2026-09-15.md §2–3B). Frame voice: the game menu is the one place the piece may explain itself, because the frame never plays and a player who opens it is reading, not being played to. `yourFileEras` are the frame's names for the four people, plain.
xrHow: Point and trigger or pinch to press. Grip away from a device opens the menu.
controlsHeadsetLines: Turn your head to look around the room. You never walk.
Point and pull the trigger, or pinch, to press.
Near a screen or handheld button, touch it with your fingertip.
Point at a marker on the floor and press to move there.
Grip a handheld, or pinch and hold, to carry it. Release to put it back.
Grip away from a device, or press the Menu tab, to open this menu.
Rooms change through pixels. Recentre sets your comfortable seat again.
Nothing here is timed. Take it off whenever you want.

jumpConfirmBody: You will go straight there and skip what comes between. You can jump back the same way.
xrSeat: Sit comfortably — press to set your seat
